headlines.text: 2021 brought us this moment: Hikaru Shida vs. Tay Conti fought tooth and nail for the AEW Women's World Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.03 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle. Hikaru Shida was chasing gold for the 10th time. A showcase of mutual respect turned rivalry ? Conti earned her shot after weeks of momentum as an in-ring standout, and the two delivered what fans widely called the highlight of the night, ending with Shida's rolling Katana knee.

That Sunday in 2024, the AEW World Tag Team Titles was up for grabs as The Young Bucks vs. FTR went to war in a Ladder match, appearing on Dynasty, rated 8.43 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle. In a ladder match tournament final to crown new tag champions, the Young Bucks got an assist from a returning Jack Perry to defeat FTR and take the vacant AEW World Tag Team Titles.
On this day in 2023, after 1 match, Varsity Athletes & Daivari debuted a bold new identity: The Varsity Athletes (Trio), on Rampage.

secondaries.text: 2024 brought us this moment: the AEW World Heavyweight Title found a new home as Swerve Strickland vs. Samoa Joe battled it out, appearing on Dynasty, rated 7.60 ? a well-worked match ? ending the champion's reign at 8 defenses. Strickland dethroned Samoa Joe to become AEW World Champion, capping his rise since Revolution with a title win at the promotion's first-ever Dynasty pay-per-view.

On a Sunday in 2024, back when Kazuchika Okada vs. PAC fought tooth and nail for the AEW Continental Title, appearing on Dynasty, rated 8.38 ? an excellent showing. PAC pushed Okada to the limit, earning a standing ovation from the crowd in defeat, but the Rainmaker lariat proved too much to retain the Continental Championship.

Looking back to 2024, when a new champion was crowned for the AEW TBS Title as Willow Nightingale vs. Julia Hart battled it out in an Open House match, appearing on Dynasty, rated 4.56 ? ending the champion's reign at 6 defenses. With Skye Blue and Kris Statlander banned from ringside, Nightingale hit a Doctor Bomb to dethrone Hart and win her first TBS Championship, only for Mercedes Mon? to immediately interrupt her celebration.
